sentences.en: To love and to be loved is the greatest happiness.
sentences.zh: 爱与被爱是最大的幸福。

sentences.en: But I'm not sure whether it brings happiness to everybody.
sentences.zh: 但我不能确定它是否能让每个人都感到幸福。

sentences.en: It goes without saying that money cannot buy happiness.
sentences.zh: 不言而喻的是，金钱买不到真正的幸福。
